question: Choose the correct synonym of **'Juvenile':**
solution:
The correct answer is: **Childish**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Juvenile"** refers to something related to young people, particularly children or adolescents. It can also describe immature or childish behavior. (किशोर / बचकाना)

 
 
• **Example:** The juvenile books section in the library has stories specifically meant for young readers.
 
 
 
• **"Childish"** means behavior or characteristics that resemble those of a child, often implying immaturity or silliness. (बचकाना)
 
 
• **Example:** His childish attitude made it difficult for the team to take him seriously.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the synonym of **"Juvenile"** is **"Childish"**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Childish**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Ancient** (प्राचीन): Refers to something very old or belonging to the distant past.

 
 
• **Example:** The ancient ruins of the temple attract thousands of tourists every year.
 
 
 
• **Grown-up** (वयस्क): Refers to an adult or someone who has matured.
 
 
• **Example:** She acts like a grown-up even though she's only fourteen.
 
 
 
• **Elder** (बुजुर्ग): Refers to someone older in age, often implying wisdom or respect due to age.
 
 
• **Example:** The elders of the community were consulted before making the decision.
